reason: I'm not putting an unaudited startup with zero customers inline in our order path. If it goes down or adds latency, that's a best-execution and outage problem I have to explain. No examiner has asked us about agent controls yet, so there's nothing pushing me to take that risk this quarter.
objection: It's another hop in front of every agent order, run by a vendor with no SOC 2 and no production track record. Our vendor risk review would stop it before I could, and if it fails, closed or open, I own the incident.
would_change_my_mind: An examiner or auditor asking us how we govern and evidence agent-initiated trades and us not having an answer, together with a finished SOC 2 Type II and published latency and failover numbers.
